text: The curriculum system of Resources and Environment focuses on the coordinated development of the exploitation and utilization of natural resources and ecological environment protection, integrating geology, ecology, environmental science, engineering technology and management. It aims to cultivate students' sustainable development capabilities for resources (such as minerals, water, energy, and biology), as well as their comprehensive qualities in solving environmental pollution (air, water, soil), ecological degradation and other problems. The course content is closely aligned with national strategies such as the "dual carbon goals", "circular economy", and "ecological civilization construction", emphasizing the integration of theory and practice, and covering the entire chain of knowledge from resource exploration to environmental governance.
